correctness_confidence.basis: Proofs of Theorem 2.3 and Proposition 3.1 and all explicit algebraic witnesses in Table 2 and Sections 5.2-5.4 verify mathematically by hand; minor prose imprecisions exist in Sections 3.1, 4.1, and 5.2, and external code/Lean files were not executed in this PDF-only review.

novelty.basis: Exact finite-field iff tropical rank-3 criterion (Theorem 2.3), zero-float birational-inverse degree-matching certificate against reducible-factor forgery (Proposition 3.1), and quantitative discovery of 22.5%-35.0% stealth-string false positives in 3D TB codes.

reproducibility.basis: Manuscript provides explicit defining polynomials, Bezout/string witnesses, birational inverses, torus homology sequences, and CLI/test descriptions, though only the PDF was inspected and code/Lean execution was not performed.

rigor.basis: Algebraic geometry arguments (Cohen-Macaulay unmixedness, faithful flatness, valuation rays, Gauss-lemma degree matching in char 2) are rigorous; however, the title and Table 1 parenthetical tags overstate the Lean 4 mechanization scope relative to Section 6.

significance.basis: Provides an exact algebraic certification primitive for 2-generator 3D CSS/TB Type-II fractons and demonstrates that axis-only and unit-box directional checks miss substantial higher-slope stealth strings.

potential_errors: Section 2.1 swaps involution bars between Eq. (1) and subsequent text.
Section 5.2 tests periods p=1,3 along ||v||_infty <= 3, so false-positive rates are rigorous lower bounds.
strengths: Theorem 2.3 (Tropical Spanning Criterion) is mathematically clean and sound.
Proposition 3.1 closes a genuine reducible-factor forgery loophole in characteristic 2.
All eight certified atlas codes (Table 2) verify algebraically by direct computation.
strong_novelty_candidates: Quantitative stealth-string taxonomy on 144 nontrivial 3D TB codes
summary: The manuscript proves the Tropical Spanning Criterion (Theorem 2.3) and characteristic-2-safe birational irreducibility certificates (Proposition 3.1) for 2-generator 3D CSS/TB codes, backed by 16 Lean 4 lemmas and a 155-code stealth-string scan. All main algebraic results are sound, with minor framing and prose imprecisions.
weaknesses: Title and Table 1 tags slightly overstate Lean 4 coverage relative to Section 6.
Verifier covers 2-generator CSS/TB genus-0 components over F4 U {infty}.
